jobs.occupation: Entry Level: Software Developer, RAN Automation
jobs.description:
Company description:
Ericsson AB
Job description:   Join our Team     We are now expanding our team and looking for a new colleague with a passion for and interest in Go full stack development!
  
 About this opportunity:
 The telecom industry is evolving rapidly, driven by cloud technologies, open interfaces, and AI. In our team, we develop applications that turn network data into insights that help customers improve network assurance and operations, with the ambition of creating an intelligent, self-healing, and self-optimizing RAN.
 As part of the team, you will work with Go, cloud-native technologies, microservices, and AI/ML, while helping us explore new ways of developing software with AI.
 We work in agile, cross-functional teams where collaboration, open communication, and continuous improvement are key. You enjoy solving complex problems, exploring new technologies, and adapting as our solutions and ways of working evolve.
  
 What you will do:
  Participate in design activities, such as analysis, design, code implementation, test development, and documentation.
 Participate in integration activities and continuously perform system integration of what has been developed.
 Follow our features all the way to customers, making sure they work as expected.
 Collaborate daily with the other team members to reach our delivery goals.
 Engage in and suggest changes to improve our performance.
  
 
 The skills you bring:
  0 to 2 years of relevant experience. New graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field are encouraged to apply.
 An interest in software development.
 Experience with programming languages such as Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python is an advantage.
 Familiarity with AI concepts and tools.
 Basic knowledge of CI/CD processes.
 A can-do personality that is positive, productive, and creative, and the ability to plan and drive your own work.
 A team-spirited mindset to reach common goals and the ability to adapt and respond to change.
 Proficiency in spoken and written English.

At Catalytic Technology, we help our customers transform ideas into successful products. We work with electronics, embedded software, FPGA design, system engineering and technical project leadership across a wide range of industries.
We are a small and highly experienced team of engineers who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and working closely with our customers. As demand for our expertise continues to grow, we are looking for an FPGA Engineer to strengthen our Gothenburg office.
About the role
As an FPGA Engineer at Catalytic, you will play a key role in developing advanced embedded and electronic systems. You will be part of a journey where we transition from traditional consulting to inhouse product development.
Your key responsibilities will be:
FPGA architecture and design
RTL development using VHDL and/or Verilog
Simulation, verification and testing
Integration with embedded software and hardware platforms

We believe you have
MSc or BSc in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics or a related field
Experience with FPGA development
Strong knowledge of VHDL, Verilog or SystemVerilog
Enthusiasm for using different AI-tools, but you don't depend on them
Experience with FPGA toolchains from Xilinx, AMD, Intel or similar vendors
Understanding of digital electronics and embedded systems
Fluent communication skills in English

The following are considered valuable merits:
Understanding of signal processing
Embedded software development in C/C++
Electronics design

What we offer
At Catalytic, you become part of a highly skilled engineering team.

We offer:
A small company environment with short decision paths
Experienced colleagues with broad engineering expertise
Opportunities to influence technical direction and company growth
Flexible working conditions

About Catalytic Technology
The people at Catalytic Technology develop electronic and embedded products from concept to production. We combine expertise in systems engineering, FPGA development, embedded software, electronics design and project management to help customers bring innovative products to market.

We are looking for an Android Developer for our team. You will be working in the heart of world-leading Android development with a team with open culture and with lots of opportunities to grow and learn. The Android based apps and service are market-leading and you will be using state of the art technologies in your daily work collaborating with other large co-operations.
Job description:
• You will work with Android development in Java, C++ and Kotlin to develop new features in all our apps for entertainment, multimedia, driver coaching apps as well as fleet management apps.
• You will be part of the biggest digital transformation in the automotive industry
• You will work with SW practices such as Scrum hybrid XP
• You will be a part of an open-minded, easy-to-talk-to Android team
 Experience required:
•You are a senior Android software developer, used to working under demanding conditions and to create a successful working climate in these situations.
• Minimum 5 years of experience from Android SW development and good understanding of commonly used Android design patterns
Skills Required:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics or equivalent
• Knowledge in working with tools such as Git, Jenkins, Jira, Artifactory as well as Android Testing Frameworks such as Espresso and UI Automator.
• As a person you are social, trustful and committed
• You need to be driven and have a true “can do” attitude together with a strong quality focus to deliver on time.
• You have excellent prioritization skills and the ability to eliminate roadblocks
• A strong ability to inspire, develop and motivate individuals and teams
• Fluent in English both written and spoken
Additional info:
We schedule interviews on a rolling basis so do not wait until end date.

Cyber Security Engineer – Automotive
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Cyber Security Engineer to join our clients project within the automotive industry.
In this role, you will work in a fast-paced, agile environment, supporting software development teams in implementing cybersecurity requirements and ensuring compliance with automotive security standards. You will play a key role in performing cybersecurity analyses, conducting reviews, and delivering work products according to ISO/SAE 21434.
Key Responsibilities
Support software development teams with automotive cybersecurity expertise and guidance.
Perform cybersecurity risk assessments, including Threat Analysis and Risk Assessment (TARA).
Develop and maintain cybersecurity work products according to ISO/SAE 21434.
Conduct cybersecurity analyses at concept and technical levels.
Collaborate with internal development teams and suppliers to review cybersecurity requirements and solutions.
Ensure alignment with automotive cybersecurity regulations, including UNECE R155 and R156.
Contribute to continuous improvements in cybersecurity processes and development practices.

Required Skills & Experience
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in cybersecurity.
Strong knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155, and R156.
Experience performing TARA and automotive cybersecurity risk assessments.
Good understanding of software development and engineering processes.
Knowledge of information security standards such as ISO 27001 / ISO 27000.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
Knowledge of functional safety (ISO 26262) and previous automotive industry experience are considered advantages.

Personal Qualities
We are looking for a proactive, driven, and solution-oriented professional with a strong interest in automotive cybersecurity. You are a collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge, solving technical challenges, and working across teams. You have excellent communication and documentation skills, a structured approach to your work, and are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
We look forward to your application!

jobs.occupation: GraphDB Specialist / Data Engineer  Neo4j & Knowledge Graph (Göteborg)
jobs.description:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced GraphDB Specialist (Data Engineer) to design, develop and maintain a central Knowledge Graph data foundation for a Cybersecurity Data Collection and Correlation (CDC) Engine.
In this role, you will work with complex data structures, security-related entities and relationships, building scalable graph database solutions. You will also contribute to integrating graph data with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines using GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying.
You will collaborate with technical teams to develop reliable data architecture, automate ingestion workflows and ensure secure and efficient access to graph data.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop Knowledge Graph architecture, ontology and data models.

Build and maintain graph data ingestion pipelines.

Implement GraphRAG and vector-graph hybrid querying to integrate graph data with LLM-based applications.

Develop and manage graph database solutions using Neo4j and Azure Cosmos DB (Gremlin).

Integrate data ingestion and graph update workflows into CI/CD pipelines.

Manage graph database configurations, updates and data relationships.

Ensure data quality, consistency, scalability and secure access to graph information.

Collaborate with engineering, AI and cybersecurity teams.

Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with graph databases, particularly Neo4j.

Experience with Azure Cosmos DB and Gremlin API.

Strong background in data engineering and data modelling.

Experience designing and developing Knowledge Graphs and ontologies.

Experience building and maintaining data ingestion pipelines.

Knowledge of CI/CD processes and integration of data workflows into automated pipelines.

Understanding of graph querying, database architecture and data relationships.

Good communication and collaboration skills.

Professional proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience with GraphRAG and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).

Experience integrating graph databases with LLM applications.

Knowledge of vector databases and hybrid search solutions.

Experience in cybersecurity, threat intelligence or security data analytics.

Experience with cloud-based data engineering solutions.

Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Technical Information Specialist to create and maintain diagnostic-related service information for the heavy vehicle industry.
You will develop clear, standardized technical content that enables workshops worldwide to troubleshoot, calibrate, maintain, and repair vehicles efficiently. The information must be structured and integrated into the relevant diagnostic tool (SWS).
The role involves working with technical documentation, diagnostic systems, and cross-functional teams within the aftermarket and E-mobility Diagnostics area.
What You Will Work On
Create and maintain fault code descriptions.
Develop step-by-step diagnostic and calibration guides.
Prepare component information and technical function descriptions.
Create and maintain user interface (UI) texts.
Develop technical illustrations.
Ensure technical information is clear, standardized, and integrated into SWS.
Work with internal tools such as OAS, Catalyst, SWS, Production Tool (PT), and GitLab.
Collaborate with relevant teams using Jira and agile methodologies.

What You Bring
At least 2–3 years of experience in a similar technical writing or technical information role.
Relevant education or experience in Technical Communication, Technical Writing, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in Swedish and English.
Basic technical knowledge and a genuine interest in vehicles.
Experience working with Jira and agile methodologies.
A valid driver's licence.
Experience in the heavy vehicle industry.
Experience with automotive diagnostics and technical service documentation.

Meritorious
Knowledge of AI applications in technical writing.
UX or front-end development skills.
Experience with OAS, Catalyst, SWS, Production Tool, or GitLab.
